name: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert to the Rescue
original_name: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert to the Rescue
overview: Get an up-close-and-personal look at Australia Zoo, and the animals who call it home, with Robert Irwin. In this short series, Robert Irwin takes us around Australia Zoo and other locations, introducing us to and teaching about different animals.
